name: dramatic
title: Dramatic
description: Theatrical weight and contrast; big pauses, strong emphasis; speeches and reveals.
instruct: Deliver with theatrical weight and gravity, strong emphasis, dramatic pauses.
sample: They told him it couldn't be done. [pause 500ms] They told him the system was too old, the code too tangled, the deadline too close. And he listened to every word. [pause 400ms] Then he did it anyway.
